_readme: Capability manifest for the curated avatar roster (V5 Character Control).
This file is the single source of truth for capability gating and card
labels — hand-reviewed, small, and diffable on purpose.
inspection    machine-derived facts read off the loaded rig; verify or
the script is report-only and never edits this file)
capabilities  the reviewed gates. fingers:true is the ONLY thing that
lets hand-landmark finger data drive a rig. Demoting a rig
whose chains pass the bar requires a fingersNote saying why
labels/coach  what the avatar cards and setup coach show.
New user-supplied models enter the roster by adding a reviewed entry here
after running the report script — there is no automatic pipeline.

labels.note: mitt hands; face-touch lands at the collar

robot.coach: The robot has mitt hands — open and fist read, finger detail won't.

capabilities.fingersNote: finger chains exist but the glove mesh is skinned as one mitt — per-finger motion deforms a blob and doesn't read (open/fist screenshots, .local/shots/v5, reviewed 2026-07-12); stays on the pose open/fist approximation
capabilities.faceTouchNote: helmet capsule radius (0.385 m) exceeds the arm reach (0.35 m) — the hand physically cannot stay outside the helmet shell, so contact reads pressed into the helmet; the v2 capsule metric exposes what the pass-2 center-distance metric hid

labels.note: mitten gloves; face-touch presses into the helmet

astronaut.coach: The astronaut wears mittens — finger motion won't show; everything else tracks.

labels.note: articulated fingers — real finger tracking in character mode

erika.coach: Erika has articulated fingers — keep your hands in frame for finger tracking.

labels.note: local file only — never ships with the app

woody.coach: Woody is a local experimental rig — conservative capabilities apply.
